    ImmutableBitSet
    ImmutableBitSet.Builder.build()
    Returns an immutable set of the bits set so far.
    static ImmutableBitSet
    ImmutableBitSet.valueOf(long word)
    Returns the set of bits that are set in word: bit n is in the set if (word & (1L << n)) != 0, for all n < 64.
    static ImmutableBitSet
    ImmutableBitSet.valueOf(long... words)
    Returns the set of bits that are set in words, in the same little-endian layout as BitSet.valueOf(long[]): bit n is in the set if (words[n / 64] & (1L << (n % 64))) != 0, for all n < 64 * words.length.

    ImmutableBitSet.toImmutableBitSet()
    Returns a collector of bit indices, the opposite of stream(): set.stream().boxed().collect(toImmutableBitSet()) equals set.
